direction: attack the measured shape-11 efficiency residue with a widened K2 autotune space, identical math
hypothesis: Shape 11 pays a measured 63.7 percent penalty against its identical-FLOP siblings and a torch-profiler diagnostic on identical bytes puts all of it in K2, which runs 2.13x slower while every other kernel is flat within 4 percent.
